messages:
Maria (Finance): Heads up — BrightOak invoice INV-4421 (2026-03-19) failed to charge: gateway returned `issuer_restricted`. Can we agree a retry/fallback plan and whether to put account on hold?
Samir Patel: ugh. do we have last4 + BIN? usually try 1 immediate retry then 2 more spaced. i'd do retries at 6h and 30h. also send update link to customer now.
Elaine (Revenue Ops): Agree on retries. For enterprise customers we usually allow a 48h grace before suspending. Is BrightOak enterprise?
Nora Chen: They're on the Growth plan, not enterprise. I'd give 48h and a grace notification. I'll reach out to their finance lead.
billing-bot: Automatic retry scheduled: attempts=3, next_attempt=6h, gateway_code=issuer_restricted, gateway_response="Card issuer restricted — contact issuer".
Trevor (Payments): Gateway X logs show `issuer_restricted`/"do_not_honor" path from acquirer. BIN is 400005xxxxxx, card not flagged for fraud. Options: ask for new card, enable ACH (if they accept), or request wire. ACH requires ACH setup (microdeposits) — 2-3 days.
Maria (Finance): Let's do this: (1) send card-update link + 48h grace email, (2) schedule retries at 6h and 30h, (3) if still failing after retries, pause billable features and open manual collection ticket. Nora — can you own customer outreach?
Nora Chen: On it. I'll ping them now and offer the card update link. I'll also ask if they'd accept an immediate wire; if yes, send our wire instructions.
Samir Patel: For the card-update email please include the last 4 and attempt timestamps. Use `pay.redwood.com/update?invoice=INV-4421` (template). Also cc finance-team@redwood.com.
Elaine (Revenue Ops): Confirming we will not auto-suspend until after the second retry. Also add note to billing: waive late fee for this one.
Trevor (Payments): If they ask for wire, confirm: we only accept wires for invoices > $10k. What's this invoice total?
Maria (Finance): INV-4421 total = $8,760. So wire is OK if they prefer, but above policy says >$10k — we can make exception with Sales sign-off. Nora, if they request wire, get Sales approval and we'll provide instructions.
Nora Chen: Got it. Reaching out now. Will update in thread.
Maria (Finance): Action items: Nora reach out; Samir update email template & enable retries; Trevor monitor gateway; Elaine waive late fee if still needed. I'll update the invoice status and reopen if collection fails. :white_check_mark: 
Samir Patel: ack.
billing-bot: Message: retry_attempt_1 scheduled at +6h from 1938201110.
Nora Chen: Customer replied — they said "card on file is corporate card; cardholder blocked the transaction for security." They will try another card and expect to update in ~2 hours.
Maria (Finance): Thanks. keep this thread updated. If we get new card, run a manual auth and let billing-bot know to cancel remaining retries.
Nora Chen: will do — closing loop once payment goes through.
